verdict.rationale: Gumloop publishes an API reference with per-endpoint pages (create agent, create session with a streaming request body), authentication docs, and Python/JavaScript SDK references, so a browsable API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
